behavior.arguments: rdi = struct base; three qword fields are read at [rdi+0x70], [rdi+0x60], [rdi+0x80]. No other argument is read.

edges.negative_span: when [rdi+0x70] < [rdi+0x60], the span term is negative (wrapping), and the third field is still added; e.g. 5 - 9 + 3 = -1 (all 64 bits).
edges.overflow: all three operations wrap modulo 2^64; e.g. 0xffffffffffffffff - 0 + 1 = 0.
edges.third_field_dominates: when the span term is 0, the result is exactly [rdi+0x80]; e.g. 7 - 7 + 11 = 11.
edges.zero_fields: when all three fields are 0, the result is 0.

behavior.entry_shape: Opens with endbr64; zero branches, zero calls; a single ret.
behavior.return_rule: Return rax = [rdi+0x70] - [rdi+0x60] + [rdi+0x80], all 64-bit wrapping. No field is written.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; zero sites found. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.
incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_note: Exactly one R_X86_64_RELATIVE record in .rela.dyn names this window as addend (full-section scan: 80,022 .rela.dyn + 278 .rela.plt entries).
